environment.capabilityCheck: Read-only CUA inventory and native accessibility-tree inspection succeeded; browser inventory explicitly reported its access host unavailable. No VoiceOver session or global accessibility setting was enabled or changed.

requiredHumanReviews.scope: Input, modal, tabs, date, help and notifications in each declared renderer; spoken names, roles, state changes, reading order, virtual cursor, live-region timing and restoration.
Real browser 200% and 400% zoom, focus visibility and content reachability. CSS zoom or smaller viewport is not equivalent.
Real operating-system high contrast and forced-colors interpretation; automated media emulation is supporting evidence only.
Real touch screen reader and gesture arbitration where supported.
Authentic audio/video, captions, transcript, audio description and sign-language equivalence and timing review; synthetic signal/geometric fixtures do not satisfy this gate.
